strategic_horizon.short_term_goal: Continue the lithium blind-memory saturation experiment on the 2015-2026 horizon using selective high-information batch3 passes. Treat the collection checkpoint as the repository-derived blind layer, preserve raw outputs immutably, measure novelty decay rather than chasing a lead-count target, and reach legitimate per-shard seal boundaries without fresh-search contamination.
strategic_horizon.next_big_step: After selective batch3 and negative-space review produce legitimately sealed shards, begin high-capability self-verification/search discovery for those shards, then convert unresolved claims into claim-scoped evidence tasks and archive original sources for the first no-lookahead Reality + Expectation + Outcome replay slice.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Stop or re-rank local work when it no longer materially improves coverage, evidence traceability, point-in-time replay, a main-path blocker, or continuity correctness. Tooling, lead count, schema elegance, lint, handoff polish and Agent orchestration are never self-justifying objectives.
